name: manual_9724fc
claim: To decide whether a Windows process can launch children outside its job, test it: start a suspended child with CREATE_BREAKAWAY_FROM_JOB and check IsProcessInJob on it; limit flags of the innermost job are not enough with nested jobs. WMI Win32_Process.Create starts processes outside the caller's job and can carry the environment in Win32_ProcessStartup.EnvironmentVariables. In PowerShell pass the script path into helpers explicitly; inside a function PSCommandPath names the file that defines the function.

decisions.notes: 2026-11-04: reading the innermost job's limit flags said breakaway was allowed while real launches stayed in the job (nested jobs). A function dot-sourced from another file saw that file in PSCommandPath and relaunched the wrong script.
